title: Tracking
schedule: Checks normally run every {hours} hours; under load, up to {max} hours. Telegram restrictions may cause longer delays.
error: Could not load tracking. Please try again.
retention: A task lasts {months} month(s). All collected messages remain available during that time and for {days} days after completion.
name: Tracking name
matchHelp: Keywords need at least {min} characters and match case-insensitive substrings. User ID matches the message sender, not mentions or forwarded authors.
noJoin: One username, link or accessible chat ID per line. The service never joins chats. Private or unreadable sources cannot be added.
botHelp: Website bell notifications are always enabled. For Telegram delivery, link your account and enable notifications in bot settings.
empty: No tracking yet. Add a group and choose what to look for.
select: Select a tracking task to view its messages.
noMessages: No matches yet. The first check runs after the initial collection interval.
overdue: Collection is delayed beyond the target interval. Check the source status.
confirmStop: Finish permanently? Collection will stop and retained data will be deleted after the retention period. To continue later, use Pause instead.

reasons.manual: Paused manually. The expiry date is unchanged. After resuming, only new messages are collected.
reasons.subscription_expired: Paid access ended. Resume manually within your current plan limit.
reasons.plan_limit: Paused because the current plan allows fewer active tasks.

errors.busy: The session is busy; retry scheduled.
errors.flood_wait: Telegram requires a cooldown. The next attempt respects that deadline.
errors.session_unavailable: The Telegram session is unavailable. Contact support.
errors.group_unavailable: The source history is no longer accessible.
errors.collection_failed: History could not be loaded; retry scheduled.
errors.pagination_stalled: Telegram repeated a page; retry scheduled without skipping data.
